_schema.format: object map: criticSlug -> { bww?, nysun?, nysr? } (all optional strings)
_schema.purpose: Override author-page slugs for sources where the registry slug doesn't match the source's URL. Loaded by audit-critic-coverage.js (S1-T7).
_schema.case-sensitive: BWW slugs MUST preserve case (e.g. Elysa-Gardner) — lowercase 404s
_schema._comment: Keys starting with _ are ignored when iterating critic entries
